tasks.title: Database migration v14 — priority column + label migration
tasks.description: Bump SCHEMA_VERSION to 14. Add `migrateToVersion14()` that adds `priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'p2'` column to issues table, creates index `idx_issues_project_priority`, and migrates existing `priority:*` labels (critical→p0, high→p1, medium→p2, low→p3, backlog→p4) removing them from the labels JSON array.
acceptanceCriteria: SCHEMA_VERSION is 14
Migration adds priority column with DEFAULT 'p2'
Index idx_issues_project_priority created on (project_id, priority)
priority:critical/p0 labels → p0, priority:high/p1 → p1, priority:medium/p2 → p2, priority:low/p3 → p3, priority:backlog/p4 → p4
Matched priority:* labels removed from labels JSON array
Issues without priority:* labels get default 'p2'
`npm run build` in packages/cli passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing migration pattern (v9 for ADD COLUMN, v2 for label parsing)

tasks.title: Update API routes for priority support
tasks.description: Update `GET /api/issues` to accept `?priority=pX` query param and filter by priority. Update `POST /api/issues` to accept optional `priority` in body with validation (400 for invalid). Update `PATCH /api/issues/:number` to accept `priority` in body with validation. Use `VALID_PRIORITIES` for validation — return 400 with 'Invalid priority' message for bad values.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues?priority=p0 returns only p0 issues, sorted priority ASC, number ASC
GET /api/issues (no priority param) returns all issues sorted by priority ASC, number ASC
POST /api/issues with priority creates issue with that priority
POST /api/issues without priority defaults to p2
POST /api/issues with invalid priority returns 400 with 'Invalid priority'
PATCH /api/issues/:number with priority updates the issue priority
PATCH /api/issues/:number with invalid priority returns 400
GET /api/issues/:number response includes priority field
`npm run build` in packages/cli passes
tasks.notes: D2 in design.md — validation at API layer only
